claims.text: 0085C0A7 writes the 3rd float of a 13-dword transform structure at [EAX] (9-dword REP MOVSD copy + 3 floats + FLD1 at +0x30); value from local float [ESP+0x10] (loaded from [ESP+0x4C] via FLD/FSTP chain).
EAX comes from [ESP+0xAC] (frame slot saved earlier, outside window); EAX==R NOT established; no join by layout similarity is made.
